description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEphemeralStrategy' that serves as a base for ephemeral connection strategies which do not influence persistence. It is part of a messaging persistence strategy package within a connectivity service, handling connectivity commands and events related to transient (ephemeral) connection state changes.

classes.name: AbstractEphemeralStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for connection strategies that handle ephemeral (temporary) connection commands without affecting persistence. It is parameterized by the command type and extends a base connectivity command strategy.

methods.name: AbstractEphemeralStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Class object representing the command type to match.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Abstract method that should be implemented to generate response headers for a given connection state and command.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Abstract method that should be implemented to provide actions to execute for the command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides a method to process the command within a context, generating a dummy event, response headers, actions, and returning a mutation result.
